TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.create_msg_delete: create a message deletion function that clears chat history and adds a placeholder for Anthropic compatibility

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.get_stock_data: get stock data for a given ticker symbol
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.get_indicators: get technical indicators for a given stock ticker

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.run_get_stock_data: run the get_stock_data tool to retrieve OHLCV stock price data for a given ticker symbol and date range
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.test_get_stock_data: test the get_stock_data tool with AAPL symbol, start date 2024-01-01 and end date 2024-12-31
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.refactor_get_stock_data: refactor the get_stock_data tool to support additional date formats beyond yyyy-mm-dd
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.review_get_stock_data: review the get_stock_data tool and its route_to_vendor call for error handling and edge cases
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.summarize_get_stock_data: summarize the get_stock_data tool that retrieves stock price data via the core_stock_apis vendor

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.summarize_get_fundamentals: summarize the get_fundamentals tool that retrieves comprehensive fundamental data for a ticker symbol
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.run_get_balance_sheet: run the get_balance_sheet tool to retrieve annual or quarterly balance sheet data for a ticker
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.run_get_cashflow: run the get_cashflow tool to retrieve annual or quarterly cash flow statement data for a ticker
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.run_get_income_statement: run the get_income_statement tool to retrieve annual or quarterly income statement data for a ticker
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.review_route_to_vendor: review the route_to_vendor function that dispatches fundamental data tool calls to the configured vendor

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.build_FinancialSituationMemory: build a FinancialSituationMemory instance to store and retrieve financial situations using BM25 similarity matching
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.create_add_situations: create a FinancialSituationMemory and add tuples of financial situations with corresponding advice recommendations
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.test_get_memories: test the get_memories method to find matching financial situations and return ranked recommendations by similarity
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.refactor_clear: refactor the clear method to reset stored documents, recommendations, and the BM25 index
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.review_FinancialSituationMemory: review the FinancialSituationMemory class and its BM25-based lexical similarity retrieval for financial advice

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.get_news: retrieve news data for a given ticker symbol within a date range
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.get_global_news: retrieve global news articles for a specified number of days with a result limit
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.get_insider_transactions: retrieve insider transaction information for a given company ticker symbol

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.parse_rating_from_text: parse a 5-tier investment rating from prose text using the parse_rating function
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.parse_rating_with_default: parse a rating from text and return a custom default when no rating is found
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.use_ratings_5_tier: use the RATINGS_5_TIER tuple to iterate over the canonical buy overweight hold underweight sell scale
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.validate_rating_label: validate that extracted text matches a valid 5-tier rating using the parse_rating two-pass strategy
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.extract_rating_from_markdown: extract a rating from markdown-formatted text that may contain bold wrappers around the rating word

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.bind_structured_output: bind an LLM to a Pydantic schema for structured output with automatic fallback to free text
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.invoke_structured_call: invoke a structured LLM call and render the result to markdown with free-text fallback on failure
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.create_structured_agent: create an agent that uses structured output binding for typed Pydantic responses from an LLM
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.build_fallback_pattern: build a graceful fallback pattern that retries a failed structured LLM call as plain free text
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.review_structured_output: review the structured output binding and invocation pattern for agent reliability and error handling

TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.run_get_indicators: run the get_indicators tool to retrieve a technical indicator for a given ticker symbol and date
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.test_get_indicators: test the get_indicators tool with a ticker symbol, indicator name, current date, and look back days
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.refactor_get_indicators: refactor the get_indicators tool to handle multiple comma-separated technical indicators
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.review_get_indicators: review the get_indicators tool that routes requests to the technical_indicators vendor
TauricResearch_TradingAgents/tradingagen.summarize_get_indicators: summarize the get_indicators tool that returns formatted dataframe results for a ticker symbol and indicator
